chars.MOM: MOM: a woman in her thirties wearing a mustard-yellow knitted cardigan over a white blouse, dark green long skirt, a small gold necklace.
chars.BOSS: BOSS: a tall man in his forties wearing a charcoal-grey three-piece suit, burgundy tie, thick black-rimmed glasses, a black leather briefcase.
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a small 7-year-old girl wearing pink pyjamas with white stars and fluffy purple slippers.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: MOM has just opened the front door and steps back, startled and suspicious; BOSS stands in the doorway with a grim, determined look, briefcase in hand. GIRL peeks curiously from behind MOM's skirt. Tense standoff at the door. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: At the open front door, BOSS puts a hand on his chest introducing himself politely but seriously; MOM crosses her arms, frowning, unsure whether to let him in. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, BOSS leans forward toward MOM with a heavy serious expression as if about to say something terrible; MOM stands frozen, holding the back of a chair. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the living room, MOM covers her mouth with both hands in total shock while BOSS nods sadly; in the background GIRL hides behind a half-open hallway door, listening wide-eyed. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: BOSS sits on the sofa looking bitter, staring down at a wedding ring in his open palm; MOM stands in front of him, stunned and pale. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: BOSS looks straight into MOM's eyes, pointing a finger firmly as he explains; MOM shakes her head in denial, one hand raised as if saying no. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: BOSS opens his briefcase on the coffee table and pulls out a thick brown envelope, holding it out to MOM; MOM stares at the envelope, afraid to take it. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: MOM sits on the sofa holding a stack of photos turned toward herself (only the white backs of the photos are visible to us), hands trembling; GIRL peeks from the hallway door behind her. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: Close-up: MOM's face in total shock, eyes wide, a single photo slipping from her fingers (only its white back visible); BOSS watches her quietly in the background. Setting: the entrance and living room of a cosy modern Moroccan family apartment with zellige tiles, a low sofa with cushions, warm evening light.
